sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Llassar Llaesgyfnewid is a Welsh god. The source names him a relatively obscure giant who owned a cauldron of great worth in the Mabinogion. The cauldron could restore the bodies of slain warriors. The evil Evnisyen turned its power against the people in a great but doomed battle with the Irish. Llassar wife Cymidei Cymeinfoll was herself a cauldron of war, for a full armored warrior sprang from her womb every six weeks. Some readers hold that the cauldron belonged to Cymidei Cymeinfoll, not to Llassar himself.
